text_description: Full-length runway look built around a fluid burgundy maxi dress with an allover white irregular lattice/grid print and pale powder-blue contrast sections. The dress has a sleeveless, high-cut bodice with narrow shoulder coverage and deep armholes, worn with a light blue high-neck layer or scarf-like collar visible at the neck. Pale blue panels appear as diagonal wrapped bands across the upper torso and waist, then reappear as abstract slashes through the skirt and as a wide contrast border near the hem, creating a graphic, scarf-print effect against the wine-red ground. The silhouette is elongated and close through the upper body, then releases into a long, softly flared, floor-skimming skirt with movement and drape around the legs. Styling is minimal and polished: hair is slicked back, the look is carried with a structured cream/off-white top-handle handbag held at the side, and black pointed-toe heeled footwear is partially visible beneath the hem.
key_elements: pale blue high-neck layer or collar
diagonal pale blue waist and torso panels
uncertainty_notes: The pale blue neck area and diagonal bands appear layered or integrated, but exact construction is not visible.
Fabric type and closures are not identifiable from the image.
